BACKEND: 12/12 pytest PASS — GET /supplier/{listings,printers/mine,papers/mine,consumables/mine} feed the All Listings table; DELETE /supplier/{listings,printers,papers,consumables}/{id} all 200/204 and rows disappear from /mine; 403 guards confirmed for admin on all three DELETE endpoints. FRONTEND: Logged in as fresh approved supplier (qa.dealer.it30.cd2e6adb@example.com). All 4 stat pills present, scroll-to-section verified (supplier-stat-listings scrolls all-listings-section to top=130 — matches scroll-mt-[130px]), supplier-stat-active correctly toggles the all-listings-filter-clear chip, All Listings combined table renders 8 rows (2 of each category) with correct Toner/Printer/Paper/Consumable badges + Active status + all-edit-* / all-delete-* buttons, cross-tab edit from a Printer's all-edit opens the printers bulk grid (bulk-submit-btn visible), edit-business-name-btn opens edit-name-dialog, tab switching after scroll still works (tab-printers→add-printer-btn, tab-toners→add-listing-btn), navbar-categories correctly hidden for dealer, hero compact ~92px. ❌ STICKY TAB BAR IS BROKEN — getComputedStyle.position='sticky' and class='sticky top-[64px] z-[90]' are present BUT after window.scrollTo(0,1500), getBoundingClientRect().top=-1068 (should be ~64). The bar scrolls away with the page instead of pinning under the navbar. Almost certainly an ancestor of [data-testid='catalog-tabs'] has overflow:hidden/auto/clip, which kills position:sticky.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid='catalog-tabs'] has `sticky top-[64px] z-[90]` and computed position='sticky' but DOES NOT stick under the navbar when scrolling — measured top went from 156 → -1068 after scrolling 1500px. An ancestor (likely a wrapper around the dashboard / DealerTabBar) has overflow:hidden|auto|clip which kills position:sticky. Fix: audit ancestors of the bar (Layout, page wrapper, any motion.div with overflow-hidden) and remove the overflow constraint, OR move the sticky bar OUT of the constrained parent into a top-level container directly under the navbar. After fix, scrolling the page should keep the bar pinned at viewport top:64.

action_items: FIX sticky tab bar: although the element has class `sticky top-[64px] z-[90]`, scroll-test proves it scrolls away with the page. Find the ancestor with overflow set and remove it (common culprits: a `motion.div` with `overflow:hidden` wrapping the dashboard, or a layout container with `overflow-x:hidden` to suppress horizontal scrollbars). Verify by scrolling 1000+px and checking the bar remains visible at the top.
(Carry-over) Auto-dismiss the 'Set your location' coachmark + cookie consent banner on first load — they continue to require manual dismissal in automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 DELETE endpoints (toner/printer/paper/consumable) correctly return 200 and the row disappears from the corresponding /mine GET. 403 guards confirmed for admin on printers/papers/consumables DELETEs — good.

The All Listings table backend wiring is implicit (4 separate GETs combined client-side in loadAllProducts). For very large suppliers this means 4 round-trips on every dashboard load — could be optimised with a `/supplier/all-products` combined endpoint later.

DealerTabBar with `sticky top-[64px] z-[90]` is the correct CSS approach, but the live page proves the sticky is broken by an ancestor overflow setting. Recommend rendering the sticky bar as a sibling of the navbar (lifted to the layout root) rather than nested inside the dashboard container — this guarantees no overflow ancestor.

all-edit-<id> for non-toner kinds correctly dispatches tc-open-edit-{printer|paper|consumable} CustomEvent that the respective listing component listens for and opens BulkUploadGeneric editMode. Verified live.
scroll-mt-[130px] on the all-listings-section anchors the scroll-to-section correctly under the navbar (64) + tab bar (~50) + small gap = ~130. Verified: section top=130 after stat-card click.

rca of the issue: Sticky tab bar bug: CSS position:sticky only sticks within the nearest scrolling ancestor. When any ancestor has overflow:hidden|auto|scroll|clip (even unrelated overflow-x:hidden to suppress horizontal scrollbars), the sticky child becomes a no-op outside that ancestor's scroll context. The class string `sticky top-[64px] z-[90]` is correct, but the parent chain breaks it. Resolution: (a) move <div data-testid='catalog-tabs'> OUT of the dashboard wrapper into the layout root (sibling of <Header>), or (b) remove the overflow on the offending ancestor. Manual reproduction: log in as qa.dealer.it30.cd2e6adb@example.com, scroll the supplier dashboard 1000px+, observe the pastel tab bar scrolls away with the content instead of remaining pinned below the navbar.
